subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T15:05:00Z
Subject: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks again for your time today  good conversation. Summary + proposed next steps below so we can get the POC kicked off next week.

Call recap (high level):
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for ACME search/assistant use case (~1M tokens/day expected in peak tests).
- Evaluation owners: Samantha (PM) + Daniel (ML lead).
- Success criteria: see attached doc  short list below.

Proposed POC success criteria (draft):
1) Latency: 95th pctile < 250ms for 512-token requests under test load.
2) Throughput: sustain 100 concurrent requests with <2s tail latency.
3) Cost: projected per-1M-token cost delta vs current baseline to be < 20%.
4) Output quality: precision@5 on sampled queries >= 0.82 (we'll define exact eval set).
5) Stability: no more than 1 transient error per 10k requests during test window.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access provisioning (API key or SSO), IP allowlist, SOW draft.
- Week 1: onboarding + integration test (sample dataset + test harness).
- Week 2: load testing & qualitative eval.
- Week 3: review results, iterate on config/quantization.

What we need from ACME this week:
- Owner for provisioning (who can receive SSO invites / provide list for IP allowlist).
- Sample dataset (anonymized) or representative queries for eval.
- Procurement contact for SOW and billing (if different).

Access options (we can support both):
- Temporary API key (fastest): we'll issue scoped key with expiry for the POC.
- SSO (SAML) invite: we can invite ACME users to a dev org if you prefer SSO.
- IP allowlist: we can allowlist specific ACME egress IPs (template attached).

Attachments: redwood-poc-success-criteria.docx, ip-allowlist-template.txt

Next steps (proposed):
- Daniel / Samantha confirm owners and whether API key or SSO is preferred.
- Marissa to send draft SOW and onboarding times; Vivek to coordinate technical kickoff.

Thanks  happy to jump on a short call if useful.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Cc: Bob Wu <bob.wu@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-10T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa  good summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: Week 0 looks good; procurement will need the SOW to start the internal process.
- SSO: we prefer SSO (SAML) for user access. Do you support SCIM for user provisioning or just SAML invites?
- Data retention & security: can you confirm default log retention and whether we can turn off logging for PII-heavy traffic?
- API key: temporary API key is fine as a fallback if SSO takes longer.

Looping in Bob and procurement for visibility. Attached our internal security contacts PDF.

Thanks  will confirm owners by EOD tomorrow.


Daniel Park
ML Engineering Lead, ACME Corp
daniel.park@acme.com

Attachment: acme-internal-security-contacts.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-11T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Appreciate the quick response, Daniel. Answers below and a couple of concrete asks.

- SSO / SCIM: We support SAML-based SSO for invitations. SCIM provisioning is not included in the standard POC flow today but we can enable it in a later phase if you want.
- Data retention: For POC orgs we default to 30 days of request logs; we can shorten retention and disable logging for particular routes if you provide a list of endpoints/paths that may contain PII. We'll capture this in the SOW.
- API key: Temporary scoped API key is fine. We'll issue it with a 14-day expiry unless you want a different window.

Requests / proposed owners: please confirm the person who will accept the SSO invite or confirm the list of IPs for allowlisting. That owner will also provide the sample dataset or a pointer to a shared drive.

I've attached a draft SOW for procurement (SOW-acme-draft.pdf). Vivek will take the technical lead on onboarding and can provide the demo key and IPs.

Proposed immediate steps (this week):
- I will: finalize SOW and share a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.
- You: confirm SSO vs API key and the owner for provisioning.
- Vivek: will propose onboarding times and produce a demo key.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW-acme-draft.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-11T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi team  happy to run the technical onboarding. Proposed first-steps and a kickoff slot below.

What I can provide this week:
- A scoped demo API key (read/write) with 14-day expiry for integration tests.
- IP allowlist: I'll provide the set of Redwood egress IPs you should allow (I'll include them in the follow-up email).
- Onboarding agenda: quick integration checklist, sample evaluation harness, and load-test plan (see attached agenda).

Proposed kickoff: Wed, 2026-03-17, 10:00 AM PT (60 min)  demo integration + run a couple of smoke tests. Let me know if that works for you.

Request for ACME: please share a small representative dataset (anonymized) and a GitHub or Drive location for our test harness.

I'll follow up with the demo key + IP list once Marissa confirms procurement path.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Attachment: onboarding-agenda.md

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@acme.com>
Cc: Bob Wu <bob.wu@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: ACME POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks Marissa/Vivek  confirms from ACME:
- Owners: Samantha Li (PM) will coordinate eval/data; Bob Wu (Procurement) will handle SOW and billing.
- Access preference: we'll start with SSO, but if that takes longer please issue the temporary API key.
- We'll share an anonymized sample dataset by EOD Friday and a Drive link for the test harness.

Procurement: Bob, can you watch for Marissa's DocuSign and let us know if any redlines are expected?

Also: please send the IP allowlist and demo key via a secure link (we prefer not to receive keys over plain email). DocuSign link for SOW would be ideal.


Samantha Li
Product Manager, ACME Corp
samantha.li@acme.com
